task_completion.description: Log into the Nx Witness VMS web or desktop client using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Nx Witness dashboard or camera resource tree after the login screen.

task_completion.description: Rename 'Server Room Camera' to 'Server Room Camera [Corridor]'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The camera name in the resource tree or settings dialog must explicitly show 'Server Room Camera [Corridor]'.

task_completion.description: Rotate the 'Server Room Camera' 90 degrees clockwise.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Camera Settings (General or Image tab), the rotation value should be set to '90' or '90°'.
The camera name in the resource tree or settings dialog must explicitly show 'Entrance Camera [Corridor]'.

task_completion.description: Rotate the 'Entrance Camera' 270 degrees counter-clockwise (or equivalent 90 degrees clockwise/270 setting).
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Camera Settings, the rotation value for this camera should be set to '270' or '270°'.

task_completion.description: Apply or Save the changes for both cameras.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Apply' or 'OK' buttons being clicked, or a 'Settings saved' notification appearing.

integrity.description: The agent used the Nx Witness GUI rather than executing scripts in a terminal to modify the database.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show mouse movements and clicks within the Nx Witness interface, not a terminal window running SQL or API commands.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus to find camera settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent right-clicking cameras or clicking the 'Settings' gear icon, rather than jumping directly to a final state screenshot.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or pasted the suffix into the name field.
integrity.visual_evidence: The cursor should be visible in the camera name text field during the renaming process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific configurations for two cameras: 'Server Room Camera' must be renamed to 'Server Room Camera [Corridor]' and rotated 90 degrees. 'Entrance Camera' must be renamed to 'Entrance Camera [Corridor]' and rotated 270 degrees. Both cameras are managed via the Nx Witness VMS at localhost:7001.
